title: Fresh Next.js command center frontend
goal: Rebuild the root frontend as a fresh Vercel/Next.js command center while preserving the worksheet JSON compiler, deterministic generation, answer checking, and static export path.
context: The user requested a fresh Next.js command-center frontend following the Vercel Web Interface Guidelines. The command center should support prompt/skill entry, structured settings, PDF-style worksheet preview, answer/trust panel, export actions, URL-backed state, and a local deterministic prompt parser. Worksheet JSON remains the source of truth.
acceptance: The root app is a fresh Next.js App Router command-center experience with prompt entry, structured setup, worksheet preview, trust panel, export actions, and mobile workflow
The current console UI implementation is removed or replaced without changing the public Worksheet JSON schema
A local parseWorksheetPrompt helper maps grade, topic/type, item count, format, and difficulty hints to existing deterministic worksheet generators without fabricating content
Stateful UI choices are reflected in URL query parameters and restored on load
Preview, answer key, answer checking, print, JSON copy, and make-another behavior compile from canonical Worksheet JSON
Changed UI follows the latest Vercel Web Interface Guidelines for labels, focus, semantic actions/navigation, live feedback, content handling, motion, and print/mobile layout
Frontend tests cover prompt parsing, filter mapping, deterministic generation, format switching, answer audit/checking, URL state helpers, and make-another seed behavior
Required validation, lint, typecheck, test, generator verification, and build commands pass
notes: Do not add accounts, auth, databases, LMS integrations, OCR, complex PDF generation, or paid/API-backed AI generation. Keep worksheet output editable and JSON-first.
